easyPrerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Yannik until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lagrella until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
